name: 8mb.local
description: 8mb.local is a self-hosted video compressor inspired by 8mb.video, free for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 4.0). Pick a target size such as 8, 25 or 50 MB and it works out the bitrate and encodes to H.264, HEVC or AV1, on the CPU or with NVENC, Quick Sync or VAAPI.

notes.text: The UI is behind HTTP Basic auth: user admin, password AUTH_PASS in /opt/8mblocal_data/.env. Change it under Settings > Authentication.
Uploads and results are deleted after 1 hour. Download results right away or raise the retention under Settings.
Hardware encoders are only offered when a test encode passes at startup. For NVENC, the NVIDIA libraries in the container must match the host driver version.
